definitions.explanation: Abbreviation of {女子高生|じょしこうせい}, referring to female high school students. Common in casual speech, advertising, and social media.

examples.english: A magazine for high school girls.

examples.japanese: JKに{人気|にんき}のカフェを{見|み}つけた。
examples.english: I found a café popular among high school girls.

examples.japanese: この{辺|あた}りはJKがよく{集|あつ}まる{場所|ばしょ}だ。
examples.english: This is an area where high school girls often gather.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Abbreviation of {女子高生|じょしこうせい} (female high school student). J = {女子|じょし} (female), K = {高生|こうせい} (high school student).

USAGE:
Very common in:
・Marketing and advertising
・Social media and internet slang
・Trend discussions
・Fashion and pop culture

NOTE:
While commonly used, be aware of context. The term can sometimes carry inappropriate connotations depending on usage.

RELATED TERMS:
・JC - {女子中学生|じょしちゅうがくせい} (middle school girl)
・JD - {女子大生|じょしだいせい} (female college student)
・DK - {男子高生|だんしこうせい} (high school boy)
